messages.subject: Having trouble with R 3.2.4
parts:
Hi Phil and all:  I downloaded R3.2.4 and ran some demo()'s available in stats which worked alright. Then I downloaded mirt and script that ran before generated a number of errors.  For example the following
[Previously saved workspace restored]

> # two groups without missing data so mod1 probably the best with facors scores 
> # all models are unidimensional 
> # item fit and some other preliminary dif based on BilogMG procedures
> library(foreign)
> library(mirt)
Loading required package: stats4
Loading required package: lattice
Error in get(Info[i, 1], envir = env) : 
  lazy-load database 'C:/Users/don/Documents/R/win-library/3.2/Matrix/R/Matrix.rdb' is corrupt
In addition: Warning message:
In get(Info[i, 1], envir = env) : internal error -3 in R_decompress1
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘mirt’
> grp2tst <- read.dta (file = "c:\\irtmirt\\diftest2grp.dta")
> colnames(grp2tst)   
Don Rock

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Having trouble with R 3.2.4
parts:
It looks like something is corrupt in your workspace, perhaps an older package which was attached. I think re-running your objects from a workspace with no defined objects would fix the problem (the R update likely is incompatible with something previously defined). 

Phil
